pages.text: I am tiny and fragile, with only three hearts of vitality, but my body is capable of true flight. I can remain aloft for ten seconds before resting on the ground to recover. I cannot rise more than eight blocks above supporting ground; over a cliff I descend gently until the land draws near again.$(br2)Heavy armor is far beyond my strength.

Hostile creatures near me become outlined, and my own body softly illuminates its surroundings. $(bold)V$() lets me perch upon another person’s head; pressing it again dismounts. $(bold)N$() produces a chiming call.$(br2)I also feel a restorative faculty behind $(bold)G$(), but its source is still unknown to me.
pages.title: Abilities and Instincts
